title: Manufactures of Metal (Present to Customs)
summary: A customs declaration where the browser reclassifies your artwork as taxable base metal, in a verdict you cannot restyle.
mechanism: Constraint Validation API: setCustomValidity() + reportValidity() raise the un-styleable, vendor-drawn native validation bubble as the customs ruling; the Appeal button clears validity to admit the unchanged object.
references: Constantin Brancusi, Bird in Space (L'Oiseau dans l'espace, 1926)
Brancusi v. United States (U.S. Customs Court, 1928)
Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
